Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.passwordmanager

Class PasswordEntry

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.passwordmanager.PasswordEntry
public class PasswordEntry extends Object
One credential in the vault: a title, the login / username, the secret itself, an optional URL and free-form notes, filed under a category. An entry is a plain Jackson bean so PasswordVault can be serialised to JSON and then sealed as a whole by VaultCrypto; the entry object only ever exists in memory while the vault is unlocked, and its password field is never written to disk in the clear (the entire vault JSON is what gets encrypted).

Every setter normalises its input (null becomes empty, strings are trimmed) so a vault round-trip can never produce a null field the UI would trip on.

    • matches

      public boolean matches(String query)
      True when query (case-insensitive) appears in the title, username, URL or category. The secret is deliberately not searched, so a filter never forces a password into a comparison.
      Parameters:
      query - the search text (null/blank matches everything)
      Returns:
      true when this entry matches
